description: Charm City Circulator Routes is a dataset listed in State of Maryland open data portal (opendata.maryland.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of Maryland. This layer contains the shapes of the four circulators (Purple, Green, Orange, Banner) as well as the three Harbor Connector Ferry Routes. The layer was converted from GTFS format to GIS format. Any and all variations are displayed in this layer. Created by Central Maryland Regional Transit (CMRT). Coverage: Maryland. Its tags are maryland open data, maryland, harbor connector, green orange, ferry routes. The table has 8 columns. The portal shows 2025-07-22 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-opendata-maryland-gov-portal.
